name: Updates animal status, creates alerts, and updates related events
script:
# Server Script Name: Animal Event - After Submit # DocType: Animal Event # Event: After Submit # Description: Updates animal status, creates alerts, and updates related events # NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE # ============================================================ # UPDATE ANIMAL STATUS ON ASSET # ============================================================ animal = frappe.get_doc("Asset", doc.animal) if doc.event_type == "Service": # Update reproductive status on Asset if hasattr(animal, "custom_reproductive_status"): animal.custom_reproductive_status = "Served - Awaiting Check" if hasattr(animal, "custom_last_service_date"): animal.custom_last_service_date = doc.service_date if hasattr(animal, "custom_pregnancy_status"): animal.custom_pregnancy_status = "Pending Check" animal.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Create pregnancy check alert/reminder if doc.pregnancy_check_due_date: existing_todo = frappe.db.exists({ "doctype": "ToDo", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.name, "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"] }) if not existing_todo: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": """🔍 Pregnancy Check Due
Animal: {0}
Service Date: {1}
Check Due: {2}
Event: {3}""".format( doc.animal, frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.service_date), frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.pregnancy_check_due_date), doc.name ), "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.name, "assigned_by": frappe.session.user, "priority": "Medium", "date": doc.pregnancy_check_due_date, "status": "Open" }) # Assign to operator if exists if doc.operator: operator_user = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", doc.operator, "user_id") if operator_user: todo.allocated_to = operator_user todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() if doc.event_type == "Pregnancy Diagnosis": # Update the related service event if doc.related_service: service = frappe.get_doc("Animal Event", doc.related_service) if doc.diagnosis_result == "Confirmed": service.db_set("pregnancy_confirmation_status", "Confirmed", update_modified=False) service.db_set("service_status", "Successful", update_modified=False) service.db_set("pregnancy_confirmation_date", doc.diagnosis_date, update_modified=False) if hasattr(service, "custom_status_after_test"): service.db_set("custom_status_after_test", "Successful", update_modified=False) # Update animal to pregnant if hasattr(animal, "custom_reproductive_status"): animal.custom_reproductive_status = "Pregnant" if hasattr(animal, "custom_pregnancy_status"): animal.custom_pregnancy_status = "Confirmed" if hasattr(animal, "custom_expected_calving_date") and hasattr(service, "expected_calving_date"): animal.custom_expected_calving_date = service.expected_calving_date animal.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Create calving alert if hasattr(service, "expected_calving_date") and service.expected_calving_date: alert_date = frappe.utils.add_days(service.expected_calving_date, -7) existing_calving_todo = frappe.db.exists({ "doctype": "ToDo", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.related_service, "description": ["like", "%Calving Expected%"], "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"] }) if not existing_calving_todo: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": """🐄 Calving Expected Soon
Animal: {0}
Expected Date: {1}
Service: {2}

Prepare calving area and monitor closely.""".format( doc.animal, frappe.utils.formatdate(service.expected_calving_date), doc.related_service ), "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.related_service, "priority": "High", "date": alert_date, "status": "Open" }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() elif doc.diagnosis_result in ["Not Pregnant", "Aborted"]: service.db_set("pregnancy_confirmation_status", doc.diagnosis_result, update_modified=False) service.db_set("service_status", "Failed", update_modified=False) if hasattr(service, "custom_status_after_test"): service.db_set("custom_status_after_test", "Failed", update_modified=False) # Update animal to open if hasattr(animal, "custom_reproductive_status"): animal.custom_reproductive_status = "Open" if hasattr(animal, "custom_pregnancy_status"): animal.custom_pregnancy_status = "Not Pregnant" animal.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Add comment to service service.add_comment("Info", text="Updated by Pregnancy Diagnosis: {0}".format(doc.name)) frappe.db.commit() if doc.event_type == "Calving": # Update animal status if hasattr(animal, "custom_reproductive_status"): animal.custom_reproductive_status = "Fresh" if hasattr(animal, "custom_pregnancy_status"): animal.custom_pregnancy_status = "Not Pregnant" if hasattr(animal, "custom_last_calving_date"): animal.custom_last_calving_date = doc.event_date # Increment lactation number if hasattr(animal, "custom_lactation_number"): current_lactation = animal.custom_lactation_number or 0 animal.custom_lactation_number = current_lactation + 1 animal.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Create re-breeding alert if hasattr(doc, "ready_for_service_date") and doc.ready_for_service_date: existing_rebreeding_todo = frappe.db.exists({ "doctype": "ToDo", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.name, "description": ["like", "%Ready for Re-breeding%"], "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"] }) if not existing_rebreeding_todo: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": """🔄 Ready for Re-breeding
Animal: {0}
Calved: {1}
Ready from: {2}

Animal has completed voluntary waiting period.""".format( doc.animal, frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.event_date), frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.ready_for_service_date) ), "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.name, "priority": "Medium", "date": doc.ready_for_service_date, "status": "Open" }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() if doc.event_type == "Movement": # Update current herd on animal if hasattr(animal, "custom_current_herd"): animal.custom_current_herd = doc.new_herd animal.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Commit all changes frappe.db.commit()

name: herd_movement_processor
VALIDATION FOR SERVICE EVENTS
script:
# Server Script Name: Animal Event - Before Save Validation # DocType: Animal Event # Event: Before Save # Description: Validates service events, pregnancy diagnosis, and calving # NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE # ============================================================ # VALIDATION FOR SERVICE EVENTS # ============================================================ if doc.event_type == "Service": # Rule 1: No second service without feedback on first service pending_services = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name, service_date, pregnancy_confirmation_status FROM `tabAnimal Event` WHERE animal = %s AND event_type = 'Service' AND docstatus = 1 AND pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Pending' AND name != %s ORDER BY service_date DESC LIMIT 1 """, (doc.animal, doc.name or "new"), as_dict=True) if pending_services: last_service = pending_services[0] days_since = frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.service_date, last_service.service_date) frappe.throw("""⚠️ Cannot record new service!

This animal has a pending service from {0} ({1} days ago).
Action Required: Complete pregnancy diagnosis for service {2} first.

Tip: Go to Animal Events → Find service → Record pregnancy diagnosis""".format( frappe.utils.formatdate(last_service.service_date), days_since, last_service.name )) # Rule 2: Check if animal is already confirmed pregnant active_pregnancy = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT ae.name, ae.service_date, ae.expected_calving_date FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae WHERE ae.animal = %s AND ae.event_type = 'Service' AND ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Confirmed' AND ae.docstatus = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` calving WHERE calving.animal = ae.animal AND calving.event_type = 'Calving' AND calving.custom_related_pregnancy = ae.name AND calving.docstatus = 1 ) ORDER BY ae.service_date DESC LIMIT 1 """, (doc.animal,), as_dict=True) if active_pregnancy: pregnancy = active_pregnancy[0] expected_calving = pregnancy.get("expected_calving_date") days_until = frappe.utils.date_diff(expected_calving, frappe.utils.nowdate()) if expected_calving else 0 frappe.throw("""🤰 Animal is Already Pregnant!

Service Date: {0}
Expected Calving: {1}
Days Until Calving: {2} days

Action: Cannot service pregnant animals. Wait for calving.""".format( frappe.utils.formatdate(pregnancy.service_date), frappe.utils.formatdate(expected_calving) if expected_calving else "Not set", days_until )) # Rule 3: Check post-partum waiting period last_calving = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name, event_date, custom_calving_outcome FROM `tabAnimal Event` WHERE animal = %s AND event_type = 'Calving' AND docstatus = 1 ORDER BY event_date DESC LIMIT 1 """, (doc.animal,), as_dict=True) if last_calving: calving = last_calving[0] days_since_calving = frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.service_date, calving.event_date) minimum_days = 45 optimal_days = 60 if days_since_calving < minimum_days: frappe.throw("""⚠️ Too Early for Service!

Last Calving: {0} ({1} days ago)
Minimum Waiting Period: {2} days
Shortfall: {3} days

Reason: Animal needs time for uterine involution and recovery.
Recommendation: Wait at least {2} days post-calving.""".format( frappe.utils.formatdate(calving.event_date), days_since_calving, minimum_days, minimum_days - days_since_calving )) elif days_since_calving < optimal_days: frappe.msgprint("""⚠️ Early Service Warning

Days since calving: {0}
Optimal waiting period: {1} days

Note: Service is allowed but conception rates improve after {1} days.""".format( days_since_calving, optimal_days ), alert=True, indicator="orange") # Set initial pregnancy status if not doc.pregnancy_confirmation_status: doc.pregnancy_confirmation_status = "Pending" if not doc.service_status: doc.service_status = "Pending" # ============================================================ # VALIDATION FOR PREGNANCY DIAGNOSIS # ============================================================ if doc.event_type == "Pregnancy Diagnosis": # Must have related service if not doc.related_service: # Try to auto-find most recent pending service recent_service = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name, service_date FROM `tabAnimal Event` WHERE animal = %s AND event_type = 'Service' AND docstatus = 1 AND pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Pending' ORDER BY service_date DESC LIMIT 1 """, (doc.animal,), as_dict=True) if recent_service: doc.related_service = recent_service[0].name frappe.msgprint("Auto-linked to most recent service: {0} from {1}".format( recent_service[0].name, frappe.utils.formatdate(recent_service[0].service_date) ), alert=True, indicator="blue") else: frappe.throw("""❌ No Related Service Found!

This animal has no pending service to diagnose.

Action Required:
1. Ensure a service event has been recorded
2. Service must be submitted (not draft)
3. Service must have 'Pending' pregnancy status

Tip: Record the service event first, then come back to record diagnosis.""") # Validate timing service = frappe.get_doc("Animal Event", doc.related_service) if not service.service_date: frappe.throw("Related service {0} has no service date!".format(doc.related_service)) if doc.diagnosis_date < service.service_date: frappe.throw("""⚠️ Invalid Diagnosis Date!

Diagnosis Date: {0}
Service Date: {1}

Diagnosis cannot be before service date!""".format( frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.diagnosis_date), frappe.utils.formatdate(service.service_date) )) days_since_service = frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.diagnosis_date, service.service_date) # Check timing appropriateness if days_since_service < 21: frappe.msgprint("""⚠️ Very Early Diagnosis

Days since service: {0}
Recommended minimum: 21 days

Note: Pregnancy detection accuracy is lower before 21 days.""".format( days_since_service ), alert=True, indicator="orange") elif days_since_service > 70: frappe.msgprint("""⚠️ Very Late Diagnosis

Days since service: {0}
Recommended maximum: 70 days

Note: This diagnosis is overdue.""".format( days_since_service ), alert=True, indicator="red") # Validate diagnosis result if not doc.diagnosis_result: frappe.throw("Please select a diagnosis result: Confirmed, Not Pregnant, or Aborted") # ============================================================ # VALIDATION FOR CALVING # ============================================================ if doc.event_type == "Calving": # Must link to pregnancy if not doc.custom_related_pregnancy: # Try to auto-find confirmed pregnancy pregnancy = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name, service_date, expected_calving_date FROM `tabAnimal Event` WHERE animal = %s AND event_type = 'Service' AND pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Confirmed' AND docstatus = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` c WHERE c.custom_related_pregnancy = `tabAnimal Event`.name AND c.event_type = 'Calving' AND c.docstatus = 1 ) ORDER BY service_date DESC LIMIT 1 """, (doc.animal,), as_dict=True) if pregnancy: doc.custom_related_pregnancy = pregnancy[0].name frappe.msgprint("Auto-linked to pregnancy from service: {0}".format( pregnancy[0].name ), alert=True, indicator="blue") else: frappe.throw("""❌ No Active Pregnancy Found!

This animal has no confirmed pregnancy to calve from.

Action Required:
1. Ensure a service has been recorded
2. Pregnancy must be confirmed via diagnosis
3. No previous calving recorded for this pregnancy

Tip: Complete the pregnancy confirmation first.""") # Validate gestation length service = frappe.get_doc("Animal Event", doc.custom_related_pregnancy) if service.service_date: gestation_days = frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.event_date, service.service_date) if gestation_days < 260: frappe.msgprint("""⚠️ Short Gestation Period!

Gestation Length: {0} days
Normal Range: 270-290 days

Note: This may indicate premature birth or abortion.""".format( gestation_days ), alert=True, indicator="orange") elif gestation_days > 300: frappe.msgprint("""⚠️ Long Gestation Period!

Gestation Length: {0} days
Normal Range: 270-290 days

Note: Verify the dates are correct.""".format( gestation_days ), alert=True, indicator="orange") # Validate calving outcome if not doc.custom_calving_outcome: frappe.throw("Please select the calving outcome: Live Birth, Still Birth, or Abortion") # ============================================================ # VALIDATION FOR MOVEMENT # ============================================================ if doc.event_type == "Movement": if not doc.current_herd: # Get current herd from animal animal_herd = frappe.db.get_value("Asset", doc.animal, "custom_current_herd") if animal_herd: doc.current_herd = animal_herd if not doc.new_herd: frappe.throw("Please select the destination herd") if doc.current_herd == doc.new_herd: frappe.throw("Current herd and new herd cannot be the same!") # ============================================================ # CALCULATE DATES FOR ALL EVENTS # ============================================================ if doc.event_type == "Service" and doc.service_date: # Calculate expected calving date (280 days) doc.expected_calving_date = frappe.utils.add_days(doc.service_date, 280) # Calculate pregnancy check due date (35 days optimal) doc.pregnancy_check_due_date = frappe.utils.add_days(doc.service_date, 35) # Calculate next expected heat if fails (21-day cycle) doc.next_expected_heat = frappe.utils.add_days(doc.service_date, 21) if doc.event_type == "Calving" and doc.event_date: # Calculate when ready for re-breeding (60 days post-partum) doc.ready_for_service_date = frappe.utils.add_days(doc.event_date, 60)

name: Update Service from Diagnosis
script:
# --------------------------------------------
# RULE: Cow must calve before next pregnancy
# --------------------------------------------

if doc.event_type == "Pregnancy Diagnosis" and doc.diagnosis_result == "Confirmed":

    # 1. Get last confirmed pregnancy BEFORE this one
    last_pregnancy = frappe.db.get_list(
        "Animal Event",
        filters={
            "animal": doc.animal,
            "event_type": "Pregnancy Diagnosis",
            "diagnosis_result": "Confirmed",
            "docstatus": 1,
            "name": ["!=", doc.name],
        },
        fields=["name", "diagnosis_date"],
        order_by="diagnosis_date desc",
        limit=1
    )

    if last_pregnancy:
        last_pregnancy_date = last_pregnancy[0].diagnosis_date

        # 2. Check if a Calving event happened AFTER that pregnancy
        calving = frappe.db.exists(
            "Animal Event",
            {
                "animal": doc.animal,
                "event_type": "Calving",
                "event_date": [">", last_pregnancy_date],
                "docstatus": 1
            }
        )

        if not calving:
            frappe.throw(
                f"🐄 {doc.animal} is already pregnant.\n\n"
                "The cow must calve before a new pregnancy can be recorded."
            )

name: Get Animal Reproductive Summary
script:
# Server Script Name: API - Get Animal Reproductive Summary
# Script Type: API
# API Method: get_animal_reproductive_summary
# Description: Returns comprehensive reproductive summary for an animal
# NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE

# Get the animal parameter
animal = frappe.form_dict.get("animal")

if not animal:
    frappe.throw("Animal parameter is required")

# Initialize summary
summary = {}

# Get current status from Asset
asset = frappe.get_doc("Asset", animal)
summary["current_status"] = getattr(asset, "custom_reproductive_status", "Unknown")
summary["pregnancy_status"] = getattr(asset, "custom_pregnancy_status", "Unknown")

# Get last service
last_service = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT name, service_date, service_type, pregnancy_confirmation_status,
           expected_calving_date
    FROM `tabAnimal Event`
    WHERE animal = %s
    AND event_type = 'Service'
    AND docstatus = 1
    ORDER BY service_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
""", (animal,), as_dict=True)

if last_service:
    summary["last_service"] = last_service[0]
    summary["days_since_service"] = frappe.utils.date_diff(frappe.utils.nowdate(), last_service[0].service_date)

# Get pending checks
pending_checks = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT name, service_date, pregnancy_check_due_date
    FROM `tabAnimal Event`
    WHERE animal = %s
    AND event_type = 'Service'
    AND pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Pending'
    AND docstatus = 1
""", (animal,), as_dict=True)

summary["pending_checks"] = pending_checks

# Get last calving
last_calving = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT name, event_date, custom_calving_outcome
    FROM `tabAnimal Event`
    WHERE animal = %s
    AND event_type = 'Calving'
    AND docstatus = 1
    ORDER BY event_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
""", (animal,), as_dict=True)

if last_calving:
    summary["last_calving"] = last_calving[0]
    summary["days_since_calving"] = frappe.utils.date_diff(frappe.utils.nowdate(), last_calving[0].event_date)

# Get service performance
total_services = frappe.db.count("Animal Event", {
    "animal": animal,
    "event_type": "Service",
    "docstatus": 1
})

successful_services = frappe.db.count("Animal Event", {
    "animal": animal,
    "event_type": "Service",
    "service_status": "Successful",
    "docstatus": 1
})

summary["total_services"] = total_services
summary["successful_services"] = successful_services
summary["conception_rate"] = (successful_services / total_services * 100) if total_services > 0 else 0

# Set response
frappe.response["message"] = summary

name: CHECK OVERDUE PREGNANCY DIAGNOSES
script:
# Server Script Name: Daily Reproductive Alerts # Script Type: Scheduler Event # Event Frequency: Daily # Description: Runs daily checks for pregnancy alerts, calvings, and problem animals # NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE # ============================================================ # 1. CHECK OVERDUE PREGNANCY DIAGNOSES # ============================================================ overdue_services = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT ae.name, ae.animal, a.asset_name, a.custom_current_herd, ae.service_date, ae.operator, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.service_date) as days_since FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae LEFT JOIN `tabAsset` a ON ae.animal = a.name WHERE ae.event_type = 'Service' AND ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Pending' AND ae.docstatus = 1 AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.service_date) > 60 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabToDo` t WHERE t.reference_type = 'Animal Event' AND t.reference_name = ae.name AND t.description LIKE '%Overdue%' AND t.status != 'Cancelled' AND DATE(t.creation) = CURDATE() ) """, as_dict=True) for service in overdue_services: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": """🚨 OVERDUE: Pregnancy Check Required

Animal: {0} ({1})
Herd: {2}
Service Date: {3}
Days Overdue: {4} days
Service Event: {5}

Action Required: Record pregnancy diagnosis immediately!""".format( service.animal, service.asset_name or "", service.custom_current_herd or "Not assigned", frappe.utils.formatdate(service.service_date), service.days_since, service.name ), "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": service.name, "priority": "High", "status": "Open", "date": frappe.utils.nowdate() }) # Assign to operator if exists if service.operator: operator_user = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", service.operator, "user_id") if operator_user: todo.allocated_to = operator_user todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() # ============================================================ # 2. CHECK UPCOMING CALVINGS (NEXT 7 DAYS) # ============================================================ upcoming_calvings = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT ae.name, ae.animal, a.asset_name, a.custom_current_herd, ae.service_date, DATE_ADD(ae.service_date, INTERVAL 280 DAY) as expected_calving, DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(ae.service_date, INTERVAL 280 DAY), CURDATE()) as days_until FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae LEFT JOIN `tabAsset` a ON ae.animal = a.name WHERE ae.event_type = 'Service' AND ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Confirmed' AND ae.docstatus = 1 AND DATE_ADD(ae.service_date, INTERVAL 280 DAY) BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` c WHERE c.custom_related_pregnancy = ae.name AND c.event_type = 'Calving' AND c.docstatus = 1 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabToDo` t WHERE t.reference_type = 'Animal Event' AND t.reference_name = ae.name AND t.description LIKE '%Calving Expected%' AND t.status != 'Cancelled' AND DATE(t.creation) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ) """, as_dict=True) for calving in upcoming_calvings: urgency = "High" if calving.days_until <= 3 else "Medium" todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": """🐄 Calving Expected Soon!

Animal: {0} ({1})
Herd: {2}
Expected Date: {3}
Days Until Calving: {4} days
Service Event: {5}

Action Required:
• Prepare calving area
• Monitor animal closely
• Have calving kit ready""".format( calving.animal, calving.asset_name or "", calving.custom_current_herd or "Not assigned", frappe.utils.formatdate(calving.expected_calving), calving.days_until, calving.name ), "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": calving.name, "priority": urgency, "status": "Open", "date": calving.expected_calving }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() # ============================================================ # 3. CHECK ANIMALS READY FOR RE-BREEDING (EXACTLY 60 DAYS) # ============================================================ ready_animals = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT ae.name, ae.animal, a.asset_name, a.custom_current_herd, ae.event_date as calving_date, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.event_date) as days_since_calving FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae LEFT JOIN `tabAsset` a ON ae.animal = a.name WHERE ae.event_type = 'Calving' AND ae.docstatus = 1 AND ae.custom_calving_outcome = 'Live Birth' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.event_date) = 60 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` s WHERE s.animal = ae.animal AND s.event_type = 'Service' AND s.service_date > ae.event_date AND s.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Confirmed' AND s.docstatus = 1 ) """, as_dict=True) for animal in ready_animals: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": """✅ Animal Ready for Re-breeding!

Animal: {0} ({1})
Herd: {2}
Last Calving: {3}
Days Since Calving: {4} days

Action: Watch for heat signs and service when detected.""".format( animal.animal, animal.asset_name or "", animal.custom_current_herd or "Not assigned", frappe.utils.formatdate(animal.calving_date), animal.days_since_calving ), "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": animal.name, "priority": "Medium", "status": "Open", "date": frappe.utils.nowdate() }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() # ============================================================ # 4. CHECK EXPECTED HEAT CYCLES (21 DAYS AFTER FAILED SERVICE) # ============================================================ expected_heats = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT ae.name, ae.animal, a.asset_name, a.custom_current_herd, ae.service_date, ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status, DATE_ADD(ae.service_date, INTERVAL 21 DAY) as expected_heat_date FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae LEFT JOIN `tabAsset` a ON ae.animal = a.name WHERE ae.event_type = 'Service' AND ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status IN ('Not Pregnant', 'Aborted', 'Failed') AND ae.docstatus = 1 AND DATE_ADD(ae.service_date, INTERVAL 21 DAY) = CURDATE() AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` s2 WHERE s2.animal = ae.animal AND s2.event_type = 'Service' AND s2.service_date > ae.service_date AND s2.docstatus = 1 ) """, as_dict=True) for heat in expected_heats: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": """🔥 Expected Heat Today!

Animal: {0} ({1})
Herd: {2}
Last Service: {3}
Last Result: {4}
Expected Heat: Today (21-day cycle)

Action: Watch for heat signs and service if detected.""".format( heat.animal, heat.asset_name or "", heat.custom_current_herd or "Not assigned", frappe.utils.formatdate(heat.service_date), heat.pregnancy_confirmation_status ), "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": heat.name, "priority": "Medium", "status": "Open", "date": frappe.utils.nowdate() }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() # ============================================================ # 5. IDENTIFY PROBLEM ANIMALS (REPEAT BREEDERS) # ============================================================ repeat_breeders = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT animal, asset_name, service_count, last_service_date FROM ( SELECT ae.animal, a.asset_name, a.custom_current_herd, COUNT(*) as service_count, MAX(ae.service_date) as last_service_date FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae LEFT JOIN `tabAsset` a ON ae.animal = a.name WHERE ae.event_type = 'Service' AND ae.docstatus = 1 GROUP BY ae.animal, a.asset_name, a.custom_current_herd HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ) as repeat_breeders WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabToDo` t WHERE t.reference_type = 'Asset' AND t.reference_name = repeat_breeders.animal AND t.description LIKE '%Repeat Breeder%' AND t.status != 'Cancelled' AND DATE(t.creation) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) """, as_dict=True) for animal in repeat_breeders: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": """⚠️ Problem Animal: Repeat Breeder

Animal: {0} ({1})
Total Services: {2}
Successful Pregnancies: 0
Last Service: {3}

Action Required:
• Veterinary examination
• Check for reproductive issues
• Consider culling if problem persists""".format( animal.animal, animal.asset_name or "", animal.service_count, frappe.utils.formatdate(animal.last_service_date) ), "reference_type": "Asset", "reference_name": animal.animal, "priority": "High", "status": "Open", "date": frappe.utils.nowdate() }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() # Log completion frappe.logger().info("Completed Daily Reproductive Alerts")

name: Get animals ready for service
script:
# Server Script Name: API - Get Animals Ready for Service
# Script Type: API
# API Method: get_animals_ready_for_service
# Description: Returns animals that completed post-partum period and ready for re-breeding
# NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE

# Get animals ready for service
ready_animals = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT 
        ae.animal,
        a.asset_name,
        a.custom_current_herd,
        ae.event_date as calving_date,
        DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.event_date) as days_since_calving,
        ae.ready_for_service_date
    FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae
    LEFT JOIN `tabAsset` a ON ae.animal = a.name
    WHERE ae.event_type = 'Calving'
    AND ae.docstatus = 1
    AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.event_date) >= 60
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` service
        WHERE service.animal = ae.animal
        AND service.event_type = 'Service'
        AND service.service_date > ae.event_date
        AND service.docstatus = 1
    )
    ORDER BY ae.event_date ASC
""", as_dict=True)

# Set response
frappe.response["message"] = ready_animals

name: Get animals needing pregnancy check
script:
# Server Script Name: API - Get Animals Needing Pregnancy Check
# Script Type: API
# API Method: get_animals_needing_pregnancy_check
# Description: Returns list of animals with pending pregnancy checks
# NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE

# Get animals needing pregnancy check
animals_needing_check = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT 
        ae.animal,
        ae.name as service_event,
        ae.service_date,
        ae.pregnancy_check_due_date,
        DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.service_date) as days_since_service,
        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.pregnancy_check_due_date) > 20 THEN 'Overdue'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.pregnancy_check_due_date) > 0 THEN 'Due'
            ELSE 'Upcoming'
        END as urgency,
        a.asset_name,
        a.custom_current_herd
    FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae
    LEFT JOIN `tabAsset` a ON ae.animal = a.name
    WHERE ae.event_type = 'Service'
    AND ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Pending'
    AND ae.docstatus = 1
    AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.service_date) >= 21
    ORDER BY ae.pregnancy_check_due_date ASC
""", as_dict=True)

# Set response
frappe.response["message"] = animals_needing_check
